description: The intention of SAREF4ENVI includes: to be the basis for enabling the use of SAREF in the environment domain; to exemplify how to enable interoperability between environmental devices in cooperation.

qualified_questions.question: [Simple] How is a lamppost classified in this system?
qualified_questions.sparql_query:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX s4envi: <http://example.org/s4envi#>

PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>

SELECT ?classification
WHERE {
  s4envi:Lamppost rdfs:subClassOf* ?classification .
  FILTER(?classification != owl:Thing)
}
